title: Research: attain 12 signed connector queries with two dirty roots
body:
The fixed signed 3×3 connector needs 14 ordinary queries with one dirty root, or 13 after paid root doubling/halving. Allowing a **second dirty root and six paid root shears** attains **12 ordinary queries**, the universal lower bound in the stated two-root interface.

**Status: research construction; no new kappa or selected-supplier admission.** The README gives the literal word, all-input identity, precise hypotheses, and a query lower bound for every positive array length. It does not claim that six transfers or the complete cost are optimal.

The balanced 2/3/4/5/6/7-factor fixture includes every child and inverse: 300 factor calls plus six root passes, versus 304 plus two scaling passes and 308 ordinary factor calls. COST.md charges the extra dirty row, three owned clean scalar registers, exact integer width, source access, restoration, compact predecessor layouts, program storage, admission, controller work, preparation and host adapters. In the declared layout, data-head movement improves only for L≥19; extra space and arbitrary weighted costs remain material. These are model counts, not a measured physical speedup.

Only `research/two-root-signed-connector/` is added. One offline command reproduces the certificate:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/two-root-signed-connector/replay.py --out /tmp/two-root-new-output
```

Expected: `PASS_TWO_ROOT_LOCAL_REPLAY queries=12 roots=2 root_passes=6 factor_calls=300 controls=28 machine_fixtures=36; no supplier admission`.

Validation on stable CPython 3.15.0:

- Free noncommutative short-word identity and a separate full elementary-matrix model: 20 dense cases, 480 basis columns per direction.
- Full recursive expansion over all dirty rows and 27 noncommuting factors; separate bounded-integer machine versus direct product evaluation on 36 fixtures and their inverses.
- Independent head-distance summation, 28 mathematical/machine controls, read-only relocation, and four actual source/certificate/program/trace corruption rejections.
- Selected-record integrity and all 25 selected binding tests pass.

The written arguments and finite checks are distinguished. The implementations were prepared with AI assistance in the same project; no independent human review, proof-assistant theorem, registered Python 3.12 replay, hosted CI, selected cold replay, or general Q/C bit-precision admission is claimed.

Seed 20 continues the previous unfinished scope. Submission base: `c111fa1d8e1708fbfe7fb7e73b00dc9fac092d80`. The package snapshot covers 722 open PRs and 268 discussion records. The immediate pre-submission refresh covers 660 open PRs and 277 discussion records, with complete pagination and no warnings. No pinned coordination issue exists; the user-authorized claim is local. Concurrent PR1615 and Discussion1486 concern the different binary universal five-source target. Scope, exact heads, coverage limits and open next questions are retained.
